title: Validation-only lr/epoch extension: locate the best lr for all dictionary heads and the linear head
description: User approved (2026-11-26, 'Yes, run it', answering 'Run the lr extension check next (validation only)'). Pre-registered before any run. Follows LR-001 / REVIEW-008 S-2: for sparse M4096 and dense M2048 accuracy still rose at lr 1e-4 (the grid edge), and the linear head was never lr-checked. VALIDATION ONLY: no ImageNetV2 or other test evaluation. Same cells as LR-001: levels source and L090, seeds 42, 43, 44 (5k pool validation split; matched-compression validation). Heads and settings as LR-001: sparse M2048 k512, sparse M4096 k1024, dense M2048 k2048 (Xavier fc, He encoder, CE + feature MSE 1/0/0), and linear (Xavier, weight decay 1e-4, CE only, as GRID-002/SEED-001). All runs train for 20 epochs at a constant lr with per-epoch reseeding, so the first 10 epochs of each run are exactly a 10-epoch run; the 10-epoch budget is evaluated from the history (best epoch <= 10 by validation top-1, then lower CE). Grid: dictionary heads lr in {1e-4, 3e-5, 1e-5} (54 runs); linear lr in {3e-3, 1e-3, 3e-4, 1e-4} (24 runs). 78 runs. New wrapper src/run_lrcheck2.py (saves full per-epoch history in done.json); existing scripts unchanged; last.pt deleted. PRE-DECLARED ANALYSIS (metric: validation top-1 of the selected epoch; 6 cells, paired by cell). Candidates: dictionary heads = LR-001's lr 3e-4 at 10 epochs (from runs/LR-001 histories) plus {1e-4, 3e-5, 1e-5} x {10, 20 epochs}; linear = {3e-3, 1e-3, 3e-4, 1e-4} x {10, 20 epochs}. (1) Per head, the best candidate c* = highest mean validation top-1. (2) Baseline b = LR-001's recommended setting at 10 epochs (sparse M2048 3e-4; sparse M4096 1e-4; dense M2048 1e-4) and, for linear, the current 1e-3 at 10 epochs. Switch rule (same as LR-001): adopt c* instead of b only if c* != b, mean(A(c*) - A(b)) >= 0.30 pp and positive in >= 5/6 cells; otherwise keep b. Report every candidate vs b (mean, sd, paired-t 95% CI df 5, sign count) descriptively. (3) Location flags: 'lower edge' if the adopted lr is the smallest lr tried for that head (dictionary 1e-5, linear 1e-4); 'upper edge' for linear if it is 3e-3; 'budget binds' if the adopted budget is 20 epochs and the median selected epoch is >= 19. An adopted setting with no flag counts as located. (4) Instability (dictionary heads; same definition as LR-001: total training loss rises > 5% between consecutive epochs), counted over 20 epochs per head x lr. (5) Sanity: the 10-epoch selection at lr 1e-4 must reproduce LR-001's lr 1e-4 cells exactly for the three dictionary heads (18 cells), and linear lr 1e-3 at 10 epochs must reproduce GRID-002 grid-xavier linear seeds 42-44 source/L090 (6 cells): same val top-1, best epoch and split digest. EXPLORATORY (labeled; validation only; selection on the same cells): sparse M2048 - dense M2048, sparse M2048 - linear and sparse M4096 - sparse M2048 at each head's adopted setting. CONSEQUENCE: the adopted settings are the proposal for a confirmatory ImageNetV2 re-test on seeds 45-51, which needs separate user approval; not run here. Caveats to disclose: k, weight decay and init were tuned at lr 1e-3 and are not re-tuned; selection optimism likely differs between peaked and monotone curves.
